description: This file contains test cases for Vitest configuration and utility functions used in the openclaw project. It includes tests for resolving worker limits, scheduling, parsing process stats, and default config for the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: resolveDefaultVitestPool
methods.description: Returns the default test pool type used by Vitest, which defaults to 'threads'.

methods.name: resolveLocalVitestMaxWorkers
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of worker threads for Vitest based on environment, system resources, and configuration overrides.

methods.name: resolveLocalVitestScheduling
methods.description: Determines scheduling strategy for Vitest based on system load, active processes, and environment variables.

methods.name: parseVitestProcessStats
methods.description: Parses process list output to count different Vitest root and worker processes and compute CPU usage percentage.
